CHARACTER DESIGN · ARC 1 CAST

Every character, creature and prop below is drawn in code as vector art. Colors and features match the series bible.

01

JONAH REED as "WREN CALLOWAY"

Protagonist · soul 24 (Earth) · body 16 (Orison) · Silt Wretch, Lv 1

skinhairstreakeyesundertowcoatbrass
  • Messy ash-black hair over the eyes, with one white streak at his left temple.
  • Sleepy gray eyes that glow violet as Undertow rises. The face never moves; that's the joke and the tragedy.
  • A thin black vein-scar from behind his right ear down his neck.
  • Outside the Pale: a tattered exile tunic, the iron tag WREN CALLOWAY · UNLIT, and mud-cracked skin leaking violet light.
  • Earth: short black hair, brown eyes, dark circles, gray hoodie and over-ear headset.
  • Lanternhall: charcoal-navy high-collar coat, brass lantern buttons, gray Null patch on the left shoulder. Usually holding bread.
Somebody had to be still. So I was.
02

THE HUSH Riptide Stalker form

Jonah's monster self · 3 m · first seen in public in Ch 9 · class: Silent

plateseammaskslitsmantle
  • Glossy black plating like wet obsidian, with glowing violet seams.
  • A smooth white bone mask with no mouth and two vertical violet eye-slits.
  • A tattered mantle of shadow-tendrils, like a drowned cloak. Long four-clawed hands.
  • The mist goes perfectly still around him. He never makes a sound, so letter his fights with silence: no SFX.
03

JUNIPER “JUNE” CALLOWAY

13 · Kindle, Lv 14 · Wren's little sister · engineer · first to see through him

haireyesjacketgogglesskin
  • A short, messy copper-red bob with brass welding goggles pushed up on her forehead.
  • Freckles, amber eyes, bandaged fingertips.
  • An oversized, grease-stained olive work jacket with rolled sleeves, plus a tool belt.
  • Her brother cried at everything. This one doesn't. She knows from the first hug.
04

OTTO WEXLEY

16 · Tinder, Lv 6 · roommate · future founder of the Order of the Hush

haireyescoatsatchelblush
  • Tall and broad, with a round face, curly chestnut hair, thick round glasses and permanently flushed cheeks.
  • His Lanternhall collar is always unbuttoned. His satchel is stuffed with notebooks and sketches of the Hush.
  • A handmade pin: a black circle with a white finger over the lips.
  • Yield 9%: he feels everything, loudly.
05

SOLENNE HOLLOWAY "the Ice Lantern"

16 · Beacon, Lv 63 · rival → investigator → partner

haireyesuniformgoldribbon
  • Long, straight silver-white hair in a high ponytail tied with a black ribbon.
  • Pale ice-blue eyes and a small beauty mark under her left eye.
  • White-and-gold Beacon honors uniform with a short white shoulder cape.
  • Matins: a slender white-gold rapier with a lantern-shaped guard. She fights with blades and lances of hard white light.

17 · Lantern, Lv 44 · enemy #1 (for now)

haireyesuniformcrimsonflame

COMMANDER IONA STRAND

09

MIRIAM & LILY REED

Jonah's mother (the game designer) · Jonah's little sister (4 at the funeral, 17 now)

Miriam haircardiganpencilLily hairraincoat
  • Miriam: warm brown eyes, dark hair in a loose bun with a pencil stuck through it, an oversized oatmeal cardigan and an ink smudge on one cheek.
  • In the game's pixel art she's a 12×11 sprite, and the pencil is in that sprite too.
  • Lily at 4: light-brown pigtails with red ties and a yellow raincoat, the only warm color at the funeral.

10

WRACKS & CRUMB bestiary

Monsters of the Spill: they hunt feeling, not sight · plus one very small friend

smokecoremaskboneCrumb eyes
  • Murmur (about Tinder): dog-sized, made of smoke and oily flesh, with no eyes. A row of whispering mouths runs along its flanks.
  • Wail (about Kindle): a heron-necked pack hunter with a white screaming mask.
  • Dirge (about Taper to Lantern): a sludge giant with a cage-ribcage and dangling hands. It kills whole squads.
  • Lament (about Beacon): a veiled weeping tower of black water with a faded red thread at its throat. Hint for Ch 10.
  • Crumb: a palm-sized puff of black mist with two white dot eyes and four stubby legs. Afraid of everything.
